description: List the visible reviews on one of your listings, newest first, with the rating summary: stars, text, the reviewer's public display name and your reply. No reviewer ids or emails, and hidden reviews are left out. Up to 100 at a time; when truncated is true, pass next_before_id as beforeId for the next page. Read-only. Submitting a listing for review is deliberately not available through MCP: it needs a human to pass the Turnstile check in the dashboard.
name: list_reviews
